request: Write a proposal for Brackenmer Dental Group from my call notes and the audit. They want Google Ads, Meta Ads and local SEO. Give them three options, and use our rate card and our usual boilerplate.

agency.name: Dunmerrow Digital (invented agency)
proof_points_with_evidence: Case study: an invented 3-location physiotherapy clinic, cost per booking from $88 to $69 over 6 months (signed client approval on file)

client.name: Brackenmer Dental Group (invented)
client.business: family and cosmetic dentistry, 4 locations in one US metro area

quotes.text: We spend about ten grand a month on Google and I honestly can't tell you what we get for it.
Half the Facebook leads never answer the phone when we call back.
When someone new moves to town and searches for a dentist, I want all four offices to show up.
Our current agency sends a 30-page PDF every month. Nobody reads it.

stated_goals.text: 40 more new-patient booking requests a month from ads
Lower cost per booking; we feel we are overpaying
All four locations show up for 'dentist near me' searches
A report the team actually reads

We handle ongoing optimization of your campaigns.
We guarantee to double your leads within 90 days.
Our clients average 4x return on ad spend.
You can reach your account team 24/7.
